sub_bugs.fix_hint: Run States 0..24 in exact binary order, move 291 to Post-Action, and skip States 12..24 when 259/283/203 cancel the turn.

sub_bugs.summary: States 9 (259) and 10 (283) are interleaved inside a single OpponentsArray loop and include Dolls instead of running all oppPlusSummons for 259 then 283.

sub_bugs.summary: State 1 (RollAilmentRecovery) omits the IsAsleep() && vtable+0x8c sleep-decay immediate removal check.
sub_bugs.reach: Sleeping units carrying sleep-decaying statuses

sub_bugs.summary: Minor state divergences: State 2 (345) omits break on first proc and scans non-candidates (X16 verified faithful in both vanilla and patched modes); State 13 (357) debuffs non-candidates; States 18..20 tick 199->339->200->204 instead of 200->204->199/339; State 22 (355) calls Wait(u) instead of keeping frozen gauge.
